zh.title: 表格原生预览、附件路径句柄与 TUI 全高视口
highlights: 桌面端原生预览 Excel 表格（xlsx/xls/ods，SheetJS 渲染，无需 LibreOffice）；文档附件随消息携带只读路径句柄，agent 可直接 read_file 读原文件，不再全盘搜索。
图片进模型历史前按字节归一格式：bmp 自动转 PNG，坏图定点换占位——单张图片不再把会话每轮请求毒化成 400。
TUI classic 全高视口（收编 PR #528）：指令摘要钉窗口顶部，窗口缩放后输入区保持贴底，/clear 只清显示不动历史。

en.title: Native spreadsheet preview, attachment path handles, and a full-height TUI viewport
highlights: The desktop app previews Excel files natively (xlsx/xls/ods via SheetJS, no LibreOffice needed); document attachments now carry a read-only path handle so the agent can read the original file directly instead of searching the disk.
Images entering the model history are normalized by byte magic: bmp is transcoded to PNG and corrupt images are replaced with a placeholder — one bad image no longer poisons every request with a 400.

Full-height classic TUI viewport (community PR #528): the prompt summary pins to the window top, the input area stays anchored to the bottom across resizes, and /clear resets the display without touching pager history.
